results.justification: Same defect (duckdb_vector_get_validity returns uint64_t* but is typed uint64 instead of intp, breaking the all-pointers-are-intp convention). New DCK-sig-COR-2 and the new XC-numbox-COR-1 report it verbatim at the same current line (ducklib.py:237); DCK-wrap-COR-1 also folds it in. Same root cause, same recommendation (retype to intp).

results.justification: Same defect (idx_t, a uint64_t, mapped to signed intp in count/size/index slots, inconsistent with duckdb.h and the file's own uint64 usage). New DCK-sig-COR-1 and DCK-wrap-COR-1 enumerate the identical slots and give the same fix. The old finding cited 6 slots (returns :105/155/156/225 and args :157/233 on the old tree); the new findings cover all of them (returns duckdb_column_count :106, duckdb_data_chunk_get_column_count :156, duckdb_data_chunk_get_size :157, duckdb_row_count :226, and idx_t args of duckdb_data_chunk_get_vector :158 and duckdb_validity_row_is_valid :234 on the current tree). Full overlap, no unmatched extra defect.
